design.snapshot: detached private scalar row array; validate order/non-overlap/frame row-count once; proof shares only within one geometry value
design.policy: return same FULL_VIRTUAL observation only for a proof-bearing unchanged policy; changed policy shares immutable geometry,never skips controller intent
design.ordinaryLists: unchanged original validation; no identity shortcut; mutable caller is never trusted
design.frameIdentity: geometry range proof never substitutes controller frame/font/layout identity
design.bounds: only currently visible rows from existing readFull; no history-prefix cache/table
design.noPerformanceEndpoints: JVM/device mechanism only; no old paired methods or new timed sampling
